about: The copy auditor's PROPOSED tier for every game, by the owner's brief: A = career, manager, front office and dynasty sims and the flagship grids (full treatment); B = distinct standalone games; C = reskins of one shared mechanic (short, and about the data set). Families are the ones routes.json worked out from shared modules. A route listed under routes overrides its family. Nothing here is decided: it is a proposal for the owner.

Soccer Career.reason: The flagship career sim and the brief's own standard.

My Career (US sports).reason: Four career sims on one engine. Deep enough for full treatment, but the four guides share a block of sentences that has to be said once.

Club Manager engine.reason: Club Manager is the deepest manager sim on the site.

Front Office.reason: Four general manager sims: cap or tax rules, draft, trades, mandate. Each league's rules differ, which is real per page content.

College Dynasty.reason: Two dynasty sims: recruiting, portal, schedule and playoff format differ by sport.

Fight sims.reason: A fighter career sim, a gym manager and a promoter sim. All three are sims with rules of their own.

Tycoon and idle.reason: Idle builders. Distinct games, not career or manager sims.

Arcade shots.reason: Two skill games (a free kick, a jump shot) with different controls and scoring.

Soccer squad builders.reason: Different games that happen to draw from one soccer player pool. Each has its own rules.

Secret player games.reason: Different games on one mystery player helper. Each has its own rules.

Champions quizzes.reason: Two different quizzes on one champions list.

Standalone.reason: Code of its own, one page.

Higher or Lower.reason: One mechanic (pick the bigger number), ten data sets.

Connect 4.reason: One mechanic (answer a trivia question to drop a disc), five question pools.

Conquest.reason: One mechanic (pick an empire, call the games), five leagues.

Perfect Season.reason: One mechanic (draft a roster and try to go unbeaten), four leagues.

Connections.reason: One mechanic (sort sixteen names into four groups), five puzzle sets.

Chain.reason: One mechanic (name someone linked to the last name), four link data sets.

Career Path guessers.reason: One mechanic (guess the player from a career revealed in steps), five sports.

Daily clue guessers.reason: One mechanic (guess the mystery entry from column feedback), eleven data sets with different columns.

Gauntlet Draft.reason: One mechanic (pick one of three cards five times, then run the gauntlet), five sports.

Missing starter.reason: One mechanic (name the missing starter from a real lineup), four sports.

Grid.reason: One grid engine, seven data sets. Which grids count as flagship (Tier A in the brief) is the owner's call; see the three overrides.

/manager-hot-seat.reason: A five game scenario on the Club Manager engine. Its own page can be short and point at Club Manager for the engine.

/deadline-day.reason: A one day transfer scenario on the Club Manager engine. Same as above.

/stadium-tycoon.reason: The deepest builder (2,082 guide words today) and one of the pages the brief says ranks in search.

/rebuild.reason: A club management game with a board, a wheel and up to four players; 2,339 guide words today.

/college-grid.reason: Flagship grid: the brief names it as a page that ranks in search.

/football-grid.reason: Proposed flagship grid (the pro football original). Owner to confirm.

/soccer-grid.reason: Proposed flagship grid (soccer is the lead sport). Owner to confirm.
